name: hyperframes-motion-director
title_zh: 把文案脚本变成中文优先的电影级动态视频
tagline_zh: 给产品发布、文章转视频、字幕动画配上 HyperFrames 渲染。不用碰英文模板，直接出中文正片。
tagline_en: Turn scripts into cinematic Chinese-first motion videos with HyperFrames. No English templates, straight to final.
desc_en: Direct and produce Chinese-first cinematic motion videos with HyperFrames. Use this skill when the user wants a rendered promo film, article-to-video piece, product launch film, website-to-video piece, keynote reveal, kinetic typography sequence, text/icon transition promo, music-synced motion graphic, HTML/CSS/SVG/GSAP video, short-form vertical video, or a landing page/product story turned into
why_zh: 它把导演流程封装成 skill：从脚本拆解到镜头节奏自动对齐，中文排版和字体渲染是默认项，不是事后修补。
why_en: It packages the directing pipeline—script breakdown to shot pacing—with Chinese typography as a default, not a patch.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 HyperFrames 渲染器，输出是 HTML/CSS/SVG/GSAP 工程而非 MP4。
limit_en: Only works with HyperFrames renderer, outputs HTML/CSS/SVG/GSAP project, not MP4. Requires Node.js + browser locally. No transcoding or color.
